 "rationale": "The cascoded EA has a gain of about 600, which meets load and line regulation. Its output follows vin, so the gate tracks ripple and PSRR improves. Indirect compensation (Cc into the cascode source) moves p2 to about sqrt(gm_p*gmc/(Cg*CL)), giving ~0.7 MHz UGB at all loads with no RHP zero. Cc also pulls the gate hard during undershoot. Budget: IREF 10 + tail 28 + divider 6 = 44 uA. Light-load gate ~1.05 V, heavy-load gate ~0.62 V, EA swing floor ~0.45 V."}

PARAMS = {
    "w_pass":     (1000.0, 500.0, 3000.0),   # PMOS pass width [um]
    "l_pass":     (0.3, 0.18, 0.6),          # PMOS pass length [um]
    "w_in":       (200.0, 60.0, 600.0),      # NMOS input pair width (L=0.5), deep weak inversion -> low Vgs, tail headroom
    "tail_ratio": (2.8, 2.0, 3.4),           # tail = tail_ratio * IREF (mirror ratio)
    "w_load":     (24.0, 8.0, 60.0),         # PMOS mirror load width (L=2) -> high ro, vin-referenced output
    "w_cas":      (40.0, 10.0, 120.0),       # NMOS cascode width (L=0.5)
    "cc":         (40e-12, 15e-12, 80e-12),  # Ahuja comp cap vout -> output-side cascode source
    "vx_head":    (0.2, 0.12, 0.35),         # target Vds of input pair (sets cascode gate via Rb)
    "rdiv":       (100e3, 60e3, 300e3),      # bottom divider resistor
}


def design(p, lut, spec):
    vin = 1.8
    vref = spec["vref"]
    vout_t = spec["vout_target"]
    imax, imin, cl = spec["iload_max"], spec["iload_min"], spec["cl"]
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)

    L_in, L_cas, L_ld, L_b = 0.5, 0.5, 2.0, 1.0
    W_b = 40.0                                   # bias diode (weak inversion, low Vgs)
    W_t = W_b * p["tail_ratio"]
    itail = iref * p["tail_ratio"]
    ib = 0.5 * itail
    Wp, Lp = p["w_pass"], p["l_pass"]
    W_in, W_cas, W_ld = p["w_in"], p["w_cas"], p["w_load"]
    R2 = p["rdiv"]
    R1 = R2 * (vout_t / vref - 1.0)
    beta = R2 / (R1 + R2)
    idiv = vout_t / (R1 + R2)

    def vgs_for(dev, W, L, Id, vds, vsb=0.0, diode=False):
        lo, hi = 0.05, 1.8
        for _ in range(40):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            d = mid if diode else vds
            if lut.op(dev, W, L, mid, d, vsb)["Id"] > Id:
                hi = mid
            else:
                lo = mid
        return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

    # ---------------- bias: cascode gate = Vgs(Mb1) + IREF*Rb ----------------
    rb = 35e3
    pred = {}
    try:
        vgs_b = vgs_for("n", W_b, L_b, iref, 0.0, diode=True)
        vtail = 0.1
        for _ in range(3):
            vgs_in = vgs_for("n", W_in, L_in, ib, p["vx_head"], vsb=vtail)
            vtail = max(vref - vgs_in, 0.02)
        vx = vtail + p["vx_head"]
        vgs_c = vgs_for("n", W_cas, L_cas, ib, 0.4, vsb=vx)
        vcas = vx + vgs_c
        rb = min(max((vcas - vgs_b) / iref, 5e3), 150e3)

        # ---------------- small-signal predictions ----------------
        op_in = lut.op("n", W_in, L_in, vgs_in, p["vx_head"], vtail)
        gm_in = op_in["gm"]
        vsg_ld = vgs_for("p", W_ld, L_ld, ib, 0.0, diode=True)
        op_ld = lut.op("p", W_ld, L_ld, vsg_ld, 0.8)
        op_c = lut.op("n", W_cas, L_cas, vgs_c, 0.4, vx)
        gmc = op_c["gm"]
        A_ea = gm_in / (op_ld["gds"] + 1e-12)

        vdo = vin - vout_t
        res = {}
        for tag, il in (("h", imax), ("l", imin)):
            ip = il + idiv
            vsg = vgs_for("p", Wp, Lp, ip, vdo)
            op = lut.op("p", Wp, Lp, vsg, vdo)
            gds = op["gds"]
            rout = 1.0 / (gds + il / vout_t + 1.0 / (R1 + R2))
            res[tag] = dict(vsg=vsg, gm=op["gm"], gds=gds, rout=rout, cgg=op["cgg"])

        ugb = gm_in * beta / (2 * PI * p["cc"])
        psrr, line = 1e9, 0.0
        for tag in ("h", "l"):
            r = res[tag]
            ol = r["gds"] * r["rout"]                     # open-loop supply gain (gate tracks vin)
            T0 = A_ea * r["gm"] * r["rout"] * beta
            T1k = T0 / math.sqrt(1 + (1e3 * T0 / ugb) ** 2)
            psrr = min(psrr, 20 * math.log10((1 + T1k) / ol))
            line = max(line, ol / (1 + T0))
        dvg = res["h"]["vsg"] - res["l"]["vsg"]
        load_reg = dvg / (A_ea * beta) / (imax - imin)
        c1 = res["h"]["cgg"]
        und = c1 / p["cc"] * dvg + imax * 25e-9 / cl
        p2_l = math.sqrt(res["l"]["gm"] * gmc / (res["l"]["cgg"] * cl)) / (2 * PI)
        pred = {
            "vout_err_pct": 0.15,
            "load_reg": load_reg,
            "line_reg": line,
            "psrr_1k": psrr,
            "undershoot": und,
            "ripple_settled": 0.003,
            "ugb_hz": ugb,
            "p2_light_hz": p2_l,
            "A_ea": A_ea,
        }
    except Exception:
        pred = {"vout_err_pct": 0.2, "load_reg": 0.4, "line_reg": 2e-4,
                "psrr_1k": 68.0, "undershoot": 0.15, "ripple_settled": 0.004}

    pred["iq"] = iref + itail + idiv

    # ---------------- netlist ----------------
    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    # bias: IREF -> Rb -> diode Mb1 ; ibias node = cascode gate
    n.R("Rb", "ibias", "nb", rb)
    n.M("Mb1", "nb", "nb", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W_b, L_b)
    n.M("Mt", "tail", "nb", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W_t, L_b)
    # NMOS input pair: fb on diode side, vref on output side
    n.M("M1", "x1", "fb", "tail", "vss", "nfet", W_in, L_in)
    n.M("M2", "x2", "vref", "tail", "vss", "nfet", W_in, L_in)
    # cascodes
    n.M("Mc1", "d1", "ibias", "x1", "vss", "nfet", W_cas, L_cas)
    n.M("Mc2", "gate", "ibias", "x2", "vss", "nfet", W_cas, L_cas)
    # PMOS mirror load (vin-referenced output)
    n.M("M3", "d1", "d1", "vin", "vin", "pfet", W_ld, L_ld)
    n.M("M4", "gate", "d1", "vin", "vin", "pfet", W_ld, L_ld)
    # pass device
    n.M("Mp", "vout", "gate", "vin", "vin", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    # feedback divider
    n.R("R1", "vout", "fb", R1)
    n.R("R2", "fb", "vss", R2)
    # indirect (Ahuja) compensation: vout -> low-Z cascode source on output side
    n.C("Cc", "vout", "x2", p["cc"])
    return n, pred
